enriched.title: Gramática e Vocabulário Prático: Perguntas no Passado e Presente
enriched.summary: A aula aborda a prática de perguntas no Simple Past e Present Simple, além de vocabulário relacionado a atividades do dia a dia e expressões úteis. Também inclui exemplos com verbos irregulares e estrutura de frases no Past Continuous.
mainTopics: Uso de perguntas no Simple Past e Present Simple

vocabulary.definition: A meal or gathering at which meat, fish, or other food is cooked outdoors on a rack over an open fire or on a portable grill.
examples: Did you have a barbecue to celebrate the victory in the championship?

vocabulary.definition: A distinct part of an organization such as a company or university, dealing with a specific area of activity.
examples: Did you change departments in the company?

vocabulary.definition: Activity requiring physical effort, carried out to sustain or improve health and fitness.
examples: What are the benefits of physical activity?

vocabulary.definition: The action of teaching a person a particular skill or type of behavior.
examples: Who is giving the training this week?

vocabulary.definition: An act of defeating an enemy or opponent in a battle, game, or other competition.
examples: Did you have a barbecue to celebrate the victory in the championship?
It was chaos at the airport last night.

vocabulary.definition: A sound, especially one that is loud or unpleasant or that causes disturbance.
examples: Who is making this horrible noise?

vocabulary.definition: Physical activity to improve health or fitness.
examples: My mother goes to the gym every day, but my father doesn’t do any exercise.

grammar.explanation: Questions in the Simple Past are formed using the auxiliary verb 'did' followed by the subject and the base form of the main verb.
rules: Use 'did' at the beginning of the sentence for questions.
The main verb remains in its base form.
examples: Did you change departments in the company?
Did you have a barbecue to celebrate the victory in the championship?
commonMistakes: Using 'did' with the past form of the main verb (e.g., 'Did you changed?').
Forgetting to use 'did' in questions (e.g., 'You changed departments?').

grammar.explanation: The Past Continuous is used to describe actions that were happening at a specific moment in the past.
rules: Can be used to describe two actions happening at the same time.
examples: At this time last year, we were planning that big project.
Thousands of people were waiting for their flights.
commonMistakes: Using the wrong auxiliary verb (e.g., 'We was planning').
Forgetting to use the '-ing' form of the verb.

expressions.meaning: to create a sound, usually loud or unpleasant
expressions.usage: Used when referring to someone or something creating a sound.
examples: Who is making this horrible noise?
Is she making this horrible noise?

practiceQuestions.question: Transforme a frase em uma pergunta no passado: 'You changed departments in the company.'
practiceQuestions.answer: Did you change departments in the company?
practiceQuestions.explanation: A pergunta no Simple Past é formada com o uso do auxiliar 'did' no início da frase e o verbo principal na forma base.

practiceQuestions.question: Traduza: 'Quem está dando o treinamento esta semana?'
practiceQuestions.answer: Who is giving the training this week?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Na estrutura do Present Continuous para perguntas, o verbo 'to be' precede o sujeito.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete com o verbo correto: 'It ______ very cold. Let’s go inside.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: O Present Continuous ('is getting') é usado para descrever uma mudança ou algo que está acontecendo agora.

culturalNotes: Nos países de língua inglesa, é comum fazer perguntas no tempo passado com o uso do auxiliar 'did', facilitando a construção da frase.
O Past Continuous é muito usado em narrativas para descrever ações simultâneas.
studyTips: Pratique a formação de perguntas no Simple Past com diferentes verbos regulares e irregulares.
Leia os exemplos em voz alta para melhorar a pronúncia e internalizar as estruturas gramaticais.
originalExamples: What will happen if Microsoft ends the partnership with OpenAI? (O que vai acontecer se a Microsoft encerrar a parceria com a OpenAI?)
Did you change departments in the company? (Você mudou de área na empresa?)
Did you have a barbecue to celebrate the victory in the championship? (Vocês fizeram um churrasco para comemorar a vitória no campeonato?)
What are the benefits of physical activity? (Quais são os benefícios da atividade física?)
Lorna often watches series in the evening, but Alice is usually on Instagram. (Lorna frequentemente assiste séries à noite, mas Alice geralmente fica no Instagram.)
My mother goes to the gym every day, but my father doesn’t do any exercise. (Minha mãe vai à academia todos os dias, mas meu pai não faz nenhum exercício.)
Do you often use public transportation? (Você usa transporte público com frequência?)
Does your family recycle paper, plastic and glass? (Sua família recicla papel, plástico e vidro?)
Do you and your friend play tennis together? (Você e seu amigo jogam tênis juntos?)
Who is giving the training this week? (Quem está dando o treinamento esta semana?)
It rains a lot here. (Chove muito aqui.)
Who is making this horrible noise? (Quem está fazendo esse barulho horrível?)
It’s getting very cold. Let’s go inside. (Está ficando muito frio. Vamos para dentro.)
At this time last year, we were planning that big project. (Nessa época no ano passado, nós estávamos planejando aquele grande projeto.)
It was chaos at the airport last night. Thousands of people were waiting for their flights. (Estava um caos no aeroporto ontem à noite. Milhares de pessoas estavam esperando por seus vôos.)
Where was grandma going when you saw her this morning? (Para onde a vó estava indo quando você a viu esta manhã?)
